en.commentary:
Where a washer is assembled decides its price in 2026, and that single fact reorders this entire category. Proclamation 10947 pulled washing machines into the Section 232 derivative list on June 23, 2025, and the April 2, 2026 proclamation applied the 25% rate to the full customs value of an imported appliance, replacing the earlier metal-content calculation. Commerce stopped accepting exclusion requests. Between June 1 and August 1 this year, ASKO, GE, KitchenAid, LG, Whirlpool and Bosch all raised list prices somewhere between 3.5% and 12%. Whirlpool went first with a 10% increase in April, its largest in a decade, then added roughly 4% more on July 9. Every sticker on this page already carries that.

So I score domestic assembly as a hard financial variable. LG runs three lines in Clarksville, Tennessee at 1.2 million washers a year. Speed Queen builds every machine it sells in Ripon, Wisconsin. Samsung operates Newberry, South Carolina. Miele ships from Germany and pays the full rate at the border. That is why the LG WM4200HBA takes first place at $1,529 list and $1,099 in the field: it delivers a 5.0 cubic foot drum, a sub-30-minute TurboWash cycle and an allergen program, from a plant sitting inside the tariff wall.

The second force reshaping this list points the other way. On July 2 the DOE proposed permanently ending appliance efficiency mandates, after a May 2025 proposal to rescind the water efficiency standard for residential clothes washers and eliminate both energy and water standards for compact washers outright. Machines on shelves today were certified against the tightened January 2024 metrics. I read that as a deadline: the efficient machine is available right now at a price that already absorbed the tariff, and a washer bought in 2026 runs until roughly 2036. Buy the efficient one while the shelf is still full of them.

My pick for anyone who plans to stay put is the Speed Queen TR7. It costs $1,499 and returns a 7-year warranty on a chassis engineered for 25 years, which lands it first on ten-year cost by a wide margin.

highlights.title: The LG WM4200HBA is the buy at $1,529, and Clarksville, Tennessee is the reason
highlights.body: LG's Tennessee plant runs three lines producing 1.2 million washers a year, which puts this machine inside the tariff wall while imported competitors absorb 25% on full customs value. The hardware earns the placement on its own: 5.0 cubic feet handles a king comforter, TurboWash 360 finishes a full load in under 30 minutes, and the AAFA-certified Allergiene cycle clears over 95% of pet dander. Street pricing lands between $1,099 and $1,289 against a $1,529 list, and I have watched that gap hold steady through two rounds of manufacturer increases this summer. That price stability is the tell. A machine built where it is sold has less room to move when the next proclamation lands.

highlights.title: Electrolux cleans better than anything else here, and $999 makes that easy to act on
highlights.body: SmartBoost premixes detergent with water before the drum turns, so the wash begins with a solution that is already active from the first minute. Reviewed put the ELFW7637AT at the top of everything it has tested, and Consumer Reports data backs the stain removal. The warranty tells you what Electrolux thinks of the build: 10 years on the motor and a lifetime warranty on the tub. At $999 to $1,299 for 4.5 cubic feet with steam, a 15-minute fast cycle and a dispenser that accepts pods, this is the machine I recommend to anyone whose laundry problem is stains.

highlights.title: Speed Queen's TR7 is the cheapest washer here once you divide by years owned
highlights.body: At $1,499 the TR7 looks expensive next to a $949 Whirlpool. Run the arithmetic over the life of the machine and it inverts. Speed Queen engineers for 25 years of average household use and backs the TR7 with a 7-year warranty, while the industry average washer life sits near 10 years. Two Whirlpools cost more than one TR7 and hand you a second delivery, a second install and a second disposal fee. Perfect Wash moves the tub and agitator together at 43dB, so it runs quieter than most front-loaders. Consumer Reports is right that the TR7 gives up cleaning points to the best front-loaders, and I still recommend it to anyone who owns their home and intends to stay.

highlights.title: The DOE rollback makes 2026 the year to buy the efficient machine while the shelf is full
highlights.body: DOE proposed on July 2 to permanently end home appliance efficiency mandates, following a May 2025 proposal to rescind water efficiency requirements for residential clothes washers and to eliminate energy and water standards entirely for compact models. Every machine on this page was certified against the tightened metrics that took effect in January 2024, and the 2026 ENERGY STAR Most Efficient tier runs on those same thresholds. A washer bought today runs into the mid-2030s on water and power rates nobody can forecast. The efficient inventory is sitting in stores right now at prices that already absorbed the tariff increases, and I would treat that as the reason to move this year.

highlights.title: The $3,299 Samsung combo charges a second washer's worth for skipping the transfer
highlights.body: The Bespoke AI Laundry Combo is a genuinely capable machine: 5.3 cubic feet, a ventless heat pump on a standard 120V outlet, AI Opti Wash reading soil and fabric, and a 98-minute wash. GE's UltraFast Combo delivers the same ventless 120V all-in-one concept at $2,299 with a two-hour wash-and-dry and a 32-load dispenser, and LG's WashCombo has traded as low as $1,699. The gap between $1,699 and $3,299 buys a full-size front-loader plus a heat pump dryer with capacity to spare. I rank all three combos below the standalone front-loaders for the same reason: a single drum doing both jobs means one broken machine takes out your entire laundry room.

zh-tw.commentary:
先講結論，2026 年買洗衣機，機器在哪裡組裝直接決定你付多少錢，而這件事把整個品類的排序重新洗了一次。美國 2025 年 6 月 23 日的第 10947 號公告把洗衣機正式納入第 232 條的衍生產品清單，2026 年 4 月 2 日的公告再把 25% 稅率的計算基礎從金屬含量改成整台的完稅價格，商務部同時停止受理排除申請。今年 6 月 1 日到 8 月 1 日之間，ASKO、GE、KitchenAid、LG、Whirlpool 和 Bosch 六家的建議售價全部調漲 3.5% 到 12%，Whirlpool 四月先調 10%，是它十年來最大一次，七月九日再加約 4%。這頁上每一個標價都已經含了這些。

所以我把在地組裝當成一個硬的財務變數在評分。LG 在田納西 Clarksville 有三條產線，年產能 120 萬台洗衣機。Speed Queen 賣的每一台都在威斯康辛 Ripon 做。Samsung 有南卡 Newberry 廠。Miele 從德國出貨，在海關把 25% 整個吃下去。LG WM4200HBA 拿第一就是這個道理，標價 1,529 美元、實際成交常在 1,099 美元，5.0 立方英尺的桶、半小時內跑完的 TurboWash、還有過敏原行程，而且它出自一座蓋在關稅牆內側的工廠。

第二股力量方向相反。美國能源部 7 月 2 日提案永久終止家電能效強制規範，在那之前 2025 年 5 月已經提案撤銷家用洗衣機的用水效率標準，小型機種的能源與用水標準則要整個取消。現在架上這些機器，都是照 2024 年 1 月生效的嚴格版指標認證的。老實說，我把這件事讀成一條截止線，省水省電的機型現在就在架上，價格也已經反映完關稅，而 2026 年買的洗衣機會一路用到 2036 年前後。趁架上還都是這種機器的時候買。

如果你住的是自己的房子而且打算長住，我會直接推 Speed Queen TR7。1,499 美元換來七年保固加一副設計壽命 25 年的底盤，十年總持有成本它是第一名，而且差距拉得很開。

highlights.title: LG WM4200HBA 值得買的關鍵在田納西那座工廠
highlights.body: LG 田納西廠三條產線一年做 120 萬台洗衣機，這代表這台機器站在關稅牆的內側，進口對手則要用整台完稅價格去繳 25%。硬體本身也撐得起這個名次，5.0 立方英尺可以洗下一整床加大雙人被，TurboWash 360 半小時內跑完一整桶，通過 AAFA 認證的 Allergiene 行程能清掉 95% 以上的寵物皮屑。標價 1,529 美元、實際成交落在 1,099 到 1,289 美元，我盯著這個價差撐過今年夏天兩輪原廠調漲。價格穩定本身就是訊號，在銷售地生產的機器，下一次公告落下來時可以動的空間比較小。

highlights.title: 洗淨力這一項 Electrolux 是這裡最強的，999 美元讓這件事變得很好下手
highlights.body: SmartBoost 會在滾筒開始轉之前先把洗劑跟水混成溶液，等於洗程第一分鐘開始就是活性溶液在工作。Reviewed 把 ELFW7637AT 放在他們測過的所有機器的第一名，Consumer Reports 的去污數據也站在同一邊。保固最能說明原廠自己的判斷，馬達保十年，內桶終身保固。999 到 1,299 美元換 4.5 立方英尺、蒸氣行程、15 分鐘快洗，投劑盒還吃得下洗衣球。講白了，如果你的洗衣痛點是污漬，這台就是答案。

highlights.title: 把價格除以使用年數，Speed Queen TR7 其實是這頁最便宜的一台
highlights.body: 1,499 美元放在 949 美元的 Whirlpool 旁邊，看起來很貴。可是把整個使用週期算進去，結論會整個翻過來。Speed Queen 是照一般家庭用 25 年在設計的，TR7 給七年保固，而業界平均洗衣機壽命大約十年。兩台 Whirlpool 加起來比一台 TR7 貴，而且你要多付一次運送、一次安裝、一次舊機回收。Perfect Wash 讓內桶和攪拌棒一起動，運轉只有 43 分貝，比多數滾筒機還安靜。Consumer Reports 說 TR7 的洗淨力比不上頂尖滾筒機，這點我同意，但只要你住自己的房子而且打算長住，我還是推這台。

highlights.title: 能效法規正在鬆綁，2026 年是趁架上還買得到省水機型的時候動手
highlights.body: 美國能源部 7 月 2 日提案永久終止家電能效強制規範，此前 2025 年 5 月已提案撤銷家用洗衣機的用水效率要求，小型機種的能源與用水標準則要整個取消。這頁上每一台都是照 2024 年 1 月生效的嚴格指標認證的，2026 年版 ENERGY STAR Most Efficient 的門檻也是踩在同一組數字上。今天買的洗衣機會用到 2030 年代中期，那時候的水費電費沒有人算得準。省水省電的庫存現在就在店裡，價格也已經把關稅漲完了，我自己是覺得，這就是今年動手的理由。

highlights.title: 三星那台 3,299 美元的一體機，等於用一台洗衣機的錢換省下一次搬衣服
highlights.body: Bespoke AI Laundry Combo 本身是很有實力的機器，5.3 立方英尺、免排風熱泵、一般 110V 插座、AI Opti Wash 會判讀髒污和材質，完整洗程 98 分鐘。問題在旁邊站著誰。GE 的 UltraFast Combo 同樣是免排風 110V 一體機，2,299 美元，兩小時洗烘完成，洗劑槽一次裝 32 次的量，LG WashCombo 更曾經下探到 1,699 美元。1,699 到 3,299 這段差價，在台灣大概就是一台全尺寸滾筒加一台熱泵乾衣機還有找。三台一體機我都排在獨立滾筒機後面，理由一樣，一顆桶子同時做兩件事，壞一次你整個洗衣間就停擺，這在台灣梅雨季特別致命。

references.title: US steel tariffs now include refrigerators, dishwashers
Labor Day 2026 Sales Preview: The Year's Last Big Mattress and Appliance Window

en.commentary: Washing machines carry more tariff exposure than almost anything else in a home. They sit under 50 percent duties on steel and aluminium content, and a washer contains up to 100 pounds of steel, which is a larger absolute exposure than any other major appliance. On top of that, the longstanding washer-specific structure applies 20 percent to the first 1.2 million units imported annually and 50 percent above that threshold. Those costs are already in current pricing and the pressure continues. Working the other way, Labor Day on September 7 has retailer sales running through September 8, and laundry is consistently one of the strongest appliance categories in that event. Buy this week. The LG WM4200HBA holds first at 9.1 because it combines genuinely excellent cleaning with the lowest ten-year running cost on this list, and LG's direct drive motor has the best reliability record among high-efficiency front loaders. The Electrolux 600 Series ELFW7637AT at 9.0 is the better choice if allergy performance and steam cycles matter to you. The Speed Queen TR7006WN at 8.7 remains the machine to buy if you want something that will still be running in twenty years.

highlights.title: Washers carry the largest absolute tariff exposure of any home appliance
highlights.body: Steel and aluminium content faces 50 percent duties, and a washing machine contains up to 100 pounds of steel. A separate washer-specific structure applies 20 percent to the first 1.2 million imported units annually and 50 percent beyond. That combination puts more tariff cost into a washer than into anything else in the house.

highlights.title: Labor Day pricing ends September 8, so decide this week
highlights.body: Retailer sales began in late August and run through September 8, with laundry consistently among the strongest appliance categories in the event. With tariff pressure continuing underneath, the gap between this week's price and October's is likely to be real money.

highlights.title: LG WM4200HBA wins on ten-year cost, and the motor is why
highlights.body: Direct drive removes the belt and the most common failure point in a front loader, and LG's record on that design is the best among high-efficiency machines. Pair excellent cleaning with the lowest running cost here and 9.1 with first place follows naturally. This is the machine I recommend to most households.

highlights.title: Buy Speed Queen if you want to do this once
highlights.body: At 8.7 the TR7006WN gives up some efficiency and some cycle sophistication, and returns a commercial-grade build that will still be washing in twenty years. If replacing appliances is something you would rather do as rarely as possible, that trade is a good one and the tariff environment makes longevity worth more.

zh-tw.commentary:
洗衣機的關稅曝險，幾乎比家裡任何東西都大。它適用鋼鋁含量百分之五十的關稅，而一台洗衣機含有多達一百磅的鋼材，這個絕對曝險量超過任何其他大型家電。除此之外，行之有年的洗衣機專項結構，對每年前一百二十萬台進口課百分之二十，超過門檻的部分課百分之五十。

這些成本已經反映在現在的價格裡，而壓力還在持續。反方向的力量是檔期：勞動節九月七號，通路特價跑到九月八號，而洗衣類在這個檔期一向是家電裡最強的品類之一。

結論是這週買。

LG WM4200HBA 以 9.1 守住第一，因為它把真正優秀的洗淨力，跟這份榜單最低的十年運轉成本結合在一起，而 LG 的直驅馬達在高效能滾筒式機種裡有最好的可靠度紀錄。

9.0 分的 Electrolux 600 系列 ELFW7637AT，適合在意過敏原處理跟蒸氣行程的人。8.7 分的 Speed Queen TR7006WN 則是「希望它二十年後還在轉」的那台。

highlights.title: 洗衣機是全家關稅絕對曝險最大的家電
highlights.body: 鋼鋁含量面臨百分之五十的關稅，而一台洗衣機含有多達一百磅的鋼材。另有一套洗衣機專項結構，對每年前一百二十萬台進口課百分之二十，超過門檻課百分之五十。這個組合讓洗衣機吃下的關稅成本，比家裡任何東西都多。

highlights.title: 勞動節價格九月八號結束，這週就要決定
highlights.body: 通路特價從八月底開跑，一路到九月八號，洗衣類在這個檔期向來是家電中最強的品類之一。底下的關稅壓力還在持續，這週的價格跟十月的價格之間，差的很可能是實實在在的一筆錢。

highlights.title: LG WM4200HBA 贏在十年成本，關鍵在馬達
highlights.body: 直驅設計拿掉了皮帶，也就是滾筒洗衣機最常見的故障點，而 LG 在這個設計上的紀錄是高效能機種裡最好的。把優秀的洗淨力配上這裡最低的運轉成本，9.1 分拿第一很自然。這是我會推薦給多數家庭的一台。

highlights.title: 想一次買到底，就選 Speed Queen
highlights.body: 8.7 分，TR7006WN 在能源效率跟行程豐富度上讓了一些，換回來的是商用等級的結構，二十年後還會在洗。如果換家電是你能多久不做就多久不做的事，這個取捨很划算，而目前的關稅環境讓耐用度更值錢。

references.title: IFA 2026: everything worth knowing about the world’s largest home and consumer electronics show
What to expect at IFA 2026: AI everywhere, robots, laptops evolved, smarter homes and more

en.commentary: Samsung and LG both pushed AI laundry heavily at IFA today, with Samsung extending its Bespoke AI line into washing machines using local neural processing to manage power, and LG showing Signature units with automated diagnostics. The idea that a machine weighs the load and adjusts water and cycle length is genuinely useful, and it is also something good machines have done with simpler sensors for years. The LG WM4200HBA holds first at 9.1 and it wins on the combination that decides a ten year purchase: cleaning performance, resource efficiency and LG direct drive reliability. A direct drive motor removes the belt, which is the component that fails first on most washers, and LG backs the motor with a long warranty. Electrolux 600 Series ELFW7637AT at 9.0 has the best stain removal and its cycles are shorter than most front loaders, which matters if you run laundry daily. Speed Queen TR7 at 8.7 is built like commercial equipment and it is the machine I would buy if I planned to keep it for twenty years. GE Profile UltraFast Combo at 8.5 washes and dries in one drum, which suits an apartment with no space for two machines. Whirlpool WFW5605MW at 8.2 is the value pick. Guidance for Taiwan: check the drain height and the water inlet type your balcony provides before ordering.

highlights.title: Direct drive removes the component that fails first
highlights.body: The belt is what breaks on most washing machines, and a direct drive motor eliminates it entirely. LG backs the motor with a long warranty, which is why it holds first on a purchase measured in a decade.

highlights.title: A washer dryer combo suits apartments with no space
highlights.body: The GE UltraFast washes and dries in one drum, which removes the need for a second machine and a vent. For a Taiwanese apartment balcony with room for one unit, that geometry solves a real constraint.

highlights.title: Speed Queen is built to be kept for twenty years
highlights.body: Commercial-grade construction and simple serviceable mechanics mean this machine outlasts everything else here. If your priority is buying once, that durability outweighs the feature list on more sophisticated models.

highlights.title: Check your balcony drain and water inlet before ordering
highlights.body: Drain height requirements and inlet fittings vary, and a machine that cannot be plumbed where you need it is an expensive delivery problem. Confirming the connections first takes minutes and prevents a return.

zh-tw.commentary:
Samsung 和 LG 今天在 IFA 都大力推 AI 洗衣，Samsung 把 Bespoke AI 線延伸到洗衣機，用本地神經處理管理耗電，LG 則展出具自動診斷的 Signature 機種。

機器秤重之後自動調整水量和洗程長度，這個概念確實實用，而好機器用比較單純的感測器做這件事也已經很多年了。

LG WM4200HBA 守第一，9.1 分，它贏在決定十年採購的那個組合，洗淨力、資源效率，加上 LG 直驅馬達的可靠度。直驅馬達拿掉了皮帶，而皮帶正是多數洗衣機最先壞掉的零件，LG 也用長保固替馬達背書。

Electrolux 600 系列 ELFW7637AT 的 9.0 去污最強，洗程也比多數滾筒機短，每天都要洗衣服的話這很重要。

Speed Queen TR7 的 8.7 用商用等級的方式製造，如果我打算留它二十年，我就買這台。GE Profile UltraFast Combo 的 8.5 在同一個滾筒裡洗完接著烘，適合沒有空間放兩台的公寓。Whirlpool WFW5605MW 的 8.2 是性價比款。

台灣的建議，下單前先確認你家陽台的排水高度和進水口型式。

highlights.title: 直驅拿掉了最先壞掉的那個零件
highlights.body: 多數洗衣機壞的就是皮帶，而直驅馬達直接把它消除。LG 用長保固替馬達背書，這就是它在一筆以十年計算的採購裡守住第一的原因。

highlights.title: 沒空間的公寓適合洗烘一體機
highlights.body: GE UltraFast 在同一個滾筒裡洗完接著烘，省掉第二台機器和排風管。台灣公寓陽台只放得下一台的情況，這個配置解掉了真實的限制。

highlights.title: Speed Queen 是打算用二十年的那台
highlights.body: 商用等級的結構加上單純好維修的機構，讓它比這裡任何一台都活得久。第一順位是「買一次就好」的話，這個耐用度勝過更花俏機種的功能表。

highlights.title: 下單前先確認陽台排水和進水口
highlights.body: 排水高度要求和進水接頭型式各家不同，一台接不上你家管線的機器，是很昂貴的配送問題。事先確認只要幾分鐘，就能避免退貨。
